storyboard.title: A young girl moves into an old haunted house
storyboard.narration: Through the cold mist, the creaking gates of the forgotten house loomed. Footsteps echoed on ancient floorboards as cold air filled the silent room. The flickering lantern light cast dancing shadows against wallpapered walls. A faint child's whisper floated down from the winding dark stairs. In the mirror's reflection, an ethereal translucent silhouette stood silently. Silver hair floating weightlessly, the spectral girl looked with gentle eyes. The spirit reached out a translucent hand, pointing toward a locked music box. The ancient brass key turned, unveiling memories preserved in dust and light. A warm golden glow replaced the cold shadows as fear turned to empathy. The ghost smiled softly, fading into starlight as a peaceful guardian of the home.
